summary: Excellent code quality across all dimensions. YAML workflow properly uses pinned action refs (actions/checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions (contents: read), and correct shell configuration (shell: pwsh). PowerShell scripts consistently apply Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference='Stop', approved verbs, -LiteralPath for file safety, and comprehensive error handling with meaningful messages. Module functions are tightly focused (single responsibility), well-decomposed for testability, and contain no dead code or repetition. Regex in ConvertTo-CanonicalStatus and StringBuilder usage in New-MarkdownSummary are appropriate optimizations. Job dependency (needs: unit-tests) is correct. Code would ship as-is; however, task requires fixture files and Pester tests to be created, which are outside this review's scope but appear absent from deliverable.
